summary: Verified new dj_live_banner_enabled admin toggle end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest (test_dj_banner_toggle.py) — GET /api/settings and GET /api/admin/settings both expose dj_live_banner_enabled; PUT /api/admin/settings persists false and true correctly across both endpoints. Frontend homepage: seeded LiveKit stream (POST /api/livekit/stream/start with location_slug=test-banner-loc, dj MIKE); with flag ON, data-testid='dj-live-streaming-btn' rendered on /. Set flag OFF via API, reloaded / → button correctly absent from DOM. Flipped back ON → button reappears. Frontend admin: /dashboard → DJ Control tab shows data-testid='dj-banner-toggle-card' immediately below emergency-broadcast-card and above ON SHIFT section (document order verified). data-testid='dj-banner-toggle-btn' initial aria-pressed='true'; clicking flips to 'false', GET /api/admin/settings confirms {dj_live_banner_enabled:false}; toast 'DJ Live banner OFF/ON' surfaced (screenshot). Second click restores to 'true' and GET confirms. Cleaned up LiveKit stream via POST /api/livekit/stream/stop; final flag left ON.

test_results.homepage_banner_hidden_when_OFF: PASS (dj-live-streaming-btn not in DOM after reload)
test_results.success_toast_shown: PASS ('DJ LIVE BANNER ON/OFF' toast visible in screenshot)

critical_code_review_comments: DJControlTab.jsx uses window.location.origin for API_URL (pre-existing carryover); recommend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to match app-wide convention. Not blocking since it works when frontend and backend share origin via ingress.
get_current_admin remains a no-op app-wide (documented) — PUT /api/admin/settings is reachable without auth. Not a regression, but a longstanding P2.

LinkTreeHomePage polls /api/settings every 30s but only /api/livekit/streams/active drives banner display; the banner already hides immediately on reload when flag flips OFF, so 30s window is acceptable per requirements.
test_credentials: admin / $outhcentral (auth is app-wide no-op; endpoint reachable without token in preview).
